bifrost: springboard/ui/src/drawing.rs, springboard/ui/src/stylus.rs, springboard/ui/src/tool_picker.rs, springboard/ui/src/lasso.rs, springboard/ui/src/markup_drawing.rs, springboard/sdk/src/drawing_model.rs, springboard/sdk/src/markup.rs, springboard/src/shell/markup.rs, springboard/apps/freeform-desktop/src/freeform.rs, springboard/apps/notes-desktop/src/notes/sketch.rs, springboard/proto/src/touch.rs
summary: Stroke and drawing models with ink kinds, a stylus mapping, a tool picker state, lasso selection, Bezier import and stroke slicing exist as pure models with host tests, and two editors draw strokes and save PNG files. No app can embed a canvas, reopen a drawing as strokes, or recognise handwriting, and the touch wire carries no tilt or altitude. iPadOS 13.0 and later per the index.
rea_evidence: not captured: tools/parity/rea-page.sh reported 'no CDP browser on 127.0.0.1:9333 (run: tools/parity/rea-page.sh --start)'; facts are from tools/parity/docc.py

features.feature: Canvas view capturing pen and finger input
features.note: the shell editor, Freeform and Notes each take touch events and stamp strokes; no SDK canvas view, so apps cannot embed one
pure drawing model; Notes saves strokes beside the picture, the shell's editor keeps strokes only in memory
StrokePoint carries position, time offset, force, altitude and azimuth in the model; the editors store x and y only
ink kinds with width ranges in the model; the editors fix width and opacity per tool

features.feature: Pen, marker, pencil and eraser tools (PKInkingTool, PKEraserTool)
features.note: the shell has four tools and Freeform three; no stroke-level eraser in Freeform
the picker state is a model; no system palette that apps attach to a canvas, and no custom tools
selection model with host tests; no move or scale of selected strokes in an editor

features.apple: PKCanvasView undo through the undo manager
features.note: stroke-level undo in the shell editor; the undo model is not connected to the Freeform or Notes editors
paths are flattened to polylines, so curve data is not kept
slicing by length fraction exists; no interpolation or animation API for apps

features.feature: Rendering a drawing to an image
features.note: PNG output from the editors; no SDK call that renders a drawing at a chosen scale

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/stylus.rs, springboard/proto/src/touch.rs (force and contact radius flags)
features.note: the digitizer mapping exists; the touch wire carries force and radius when the panel reports them but no tilt, and the editors do not use force for width
no recogniser; springboard/sdk/src/spellcheck.rs works on typed text only
no handwriting path into text fields or other views

features.apple: Apple Pencil double tap and squeeze
features.note: no pen button or tap events reach apps

features.feature: Serialised drawing format and ink versions
features.note: Notes writes its own .sketch file; no versioned format is shared with apps

gaps: No SDK canvas view: apps cannot capture, draw, store or reopen strokes.
The touch wire has no tilt, altitude or azimuth, and the editors do not map pressure to width.
No handwriting recognition and no Scribble-style input.
No system tool picker that apps attach to a canvas; the editors keep their own tool rows.
No pen button or tap events, and no versioned drawing format shared between apps.
